{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''pirate base''' was located somewhere near the [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]]. The base was in a domed building with stairs and a doorway that resembled a set of five [[Serianan statue|statues]] recovered from the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Korren Starchaser]]. Within the base, the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] held a sixth statue that completed the set found by Starchaser.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
At one point, the pirates captured a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were heading into the Serianan system and brought them to the pirate base. The captives explored the base and found its connection to the statues from the [[Serianan Belt]]. They managed to steal the sixth statue and escape the base.
{{Endgame}}
